Class LayoutValue<T>

Namespace: osu.Framework.Layout
Assembly: osu.Framework.dll

A member that represents the validation state of a value in the layout of a osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable. Can be invalidated according to state changes in a osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable (via osu.Framework.Graphics.Invalidation flags), and validated when an up-to-date value is set.

public class LayoutValue<T> : LayoutMember
